plausibility_notes: Ella becomes the strongest accusation at this stage. Her newly admitted glass handling, proximity to an open miniature and disposal of gift scraps converge with the laboratory transfer chain and fitted original-bottle fragment. Her earlier social-exposure motive is substantial.

Al drops because exterior plaster is nonspecific and Frank provides another source; Al maintains an unopened favor and invites examination. Brie remains a credible alternative through direct glass handling and deliberate absence, but has no comparable open-miniature/disposal link.

A reasonable accusation of Ella is justified now, with remaining uncertainty: the miniature and favor paper have no recipient identification, another guest could have contaminated the glass before Ella cleared innocent-looking scraps, and there is no direct proof placing Ella at the cabinet theft.

Final statements supply many useful qualifications but an unusually uniform forensic disclaimer rhythm. The crucial inference depends on cross-referencing Ella's terse admission with earlier lab evidence.
